# Chemistry Core
The Chemistry Unbound overview describes CHEM 150/L Structure and Properties, 202/L Principles of Reactivity, 203/L Advanced Reactivity, 204/L Macromolecules, 205/L Light and Matter, and 300L Analytical Tools and Techniques.
# Laboratory Timing
The chemistry department says labs are co-requisites and may be taken concurrently with or after their lecture courses.
# BA and BS Planning
The department overview describes a shared chemistry core for BA and BS students. Its non-chemistry coursework differs: it lists one semester of calculus for the BA and two for the BS, alongside biology and physics expectations. Check the current catalog for individual degree requirements.
# Chemistry Research Course
The department overview says CHEM 499R can substitute for the BS non-writing laboratory elective; verify applicability with the current catalog and advisor.
